h1: The 7 Best Chair Mats for Thick Carpet of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Chair Mats for Thick Carpet: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven chair mats for thick carpet, matched to pile depth, padding, size and material so your chair rolls without sinking.
summary: The ES Robbins Extra High Pile mat with a lip is our top pick because it is rated for carpet over 1 inch deep, padding included. The Marvelux Extra Thick is the choice if you want one mat rated for any pile. The Floortex medium to high pile mat is the sensible pick for typical plush office carpet, and the larger Floortex and ES Robbins EverLife mats suit wide desks.
intro: The single biggest mistake with a chair mat on thick carpet is buying by size and looks while ignoring the pile rating. A mat built for low pile will sink, curl and rock on deep plush, and the chair will feel like it is rolling through sand. The rating that matters is the carpet depth the mat is made to sit on, padding included.

We reviewed seven mats made for deep carpet and ranked them on the pile depth each is rated for, material and thickness, usable size and whether a lip is included. All details come from listing specifications and are not the result of any claimed floor trials. One dual-use hardwood mat was excluded.

products.name: ES Robbins Extra High Pile Chair Mat with Lip
products.verdict: A 36 by 48 inch vinyl mat rated for carpet over an inch deep, padding included.
products.description:
At 36 by 48 inches with a lip and 0.2 inch of vinyl, this ES Robbins is built for the deepest carpets: the maker counts padding in the figure and claims it works past 1 inch.

It ranks first because the pile rating is the highest and it comes in a standard size, so most desks fit. The Marvelux Extra Thick is similar in thickness, but it is a bigger mat at higher cost.

Buy it if your carpet is genuinely deep and your desk is a standard size. The caveat is that vinyl is softer than polycarbonate.
products.idealFor: Deep plush carpet and a standard-size desk.
products.skipIf: You want a mat bigger than 36 x 48.

products.name: Marvelux Extra Thick Polycarbonate Chair Mat All Carpets
products.verdict: The thickest mat here, rated for every carpet depth including plush.
products.description:
The Marvelux Extra Thick is a 46 by 60 inch polycarbonate mat, 0.2 inch thick, the thickest in this guide, and rated for all carpet thicknesses including very high pile.

It ranks second because one rating covers any carpet you might own or move to. Compared with the ES Robbins above, it is larger and costs more, in the $100-200 bucket.

Choose it if you want a single mat for any floor. The caveat is size, so check it fits your room.
products.idealFor: People unsure of their carpet depth or likely to move.

products.award: Best for Medium to High Pile
products.name: Floortex Polycarbonate Chair Mat for Deep Pile Carpet
products.verdict: A 35 by 47 inch polycarbonate mat for pile over half an inch.
products.description:
The Floortex is a 35 by 47 inch polycarbonate sheet, 0.11 inch thick, aimed at medium and high pile that is more than half an inch deep.

It ranks third because the rating tops out below the ES Robbins and Marvelux, but its price in the $50-100 bucket makes it the sensible pick for typical plush office carpet.

Buy it for carpet that is thick but not extreme. The caveat is that it is not for very deep pile.
products.skipIf: Your carpet is deeper than about an inch.

products.award: Best Extra High with Roll Room
products.name: ES Robbins EverLife Extra High Pile Chair Mat
products.verdict: A 45 by 53 inch vinyl mat with an extended lip for deep carpet.
products.description:
The EverLife stretches to 45 by 53 inches of 0.2 inch vinyl, with a separate 25 by 12 inch lip, and targets pile deeper than 1 inch.

It ranks fourth because it is the roomy version of the ES Robbins top pick, though it costs more. The extended lip helps with a deep desk.

Choose it when you need both deep-carpet support and more rolling space. The caveat is the footprint.
products.idealFor: Deep carpet with a larger desk area.

products.name: Floortex Polycarbonate Chair Mat for Plush Pile
products.verdict: The largest Floortex footprint, rated for high or thick pile.
products.description:
This Floortex is the roomiest in its line at 48 by 60 inches of 0.11 inch polycarbonate, made for high or thick plush pile.

It ranks fifth because the size is its main appeal; it is thinner than the Marvelux Extra Thick at a similar price. It suits a wide workspace.

Buy it for an L-shaped desk on plush carpet. The caveat is that 0.11 inch thickness is modest for the largest sizes.
products.idealFor: Wide or L-shaped desks on plush carpet.

products.name: Marvelux Polycarbonate Chair Mat for High Pile Carpet
products.verdict: A 48 by 60 inch mat rated up to three quarters of an inch, padding included.
products.description:
The Marvelux High Pile gives you 48 by 60 inches of 0.11 inch polycarbonate, and its depth limit of three quarters of an inch already counts the padding underneath.

It ranks sixth because the padding-inclusive rating is an honest figure, but it is a lower ceiling than the extra-high options. It costs in the $100-200 bucket.

Choose it if padding adds to your carpet depth and you need a large mat. The caveat is the price for that size.
products.idealFor: Large desks on carpet with a padded underlay.
products.skipIf: Your carpet is more than 3/4 inch deep.

products.name: ES Robbins EverLife High Pile Chair Mat
products.verdict: A 46 by 60 inch vinyl mat for high pile up to an inch.
products.description:
The EverLife High Pile covers 46 by 60 inches with 0.17 inch vinyl, sized for carpet that reaches up to 1 inch.

It ranks last because the pile rating and thickness sit below the EverLife Extra High, while it costs similar money. Its size is the main selling point.

Pick it for a wide setup on high pile. The caveat is that deeper carpet needs the extra-high versions.

whatMatters.detail: Pile rating states the carpet depth a mat is built for. A mat rated for low pile sinks and curls on deep plush. Check the rating in the title or bullets, and note if it includes padding.

Underlay adds to the effective depth your mat sits on. Marvelux High Pile includes padding in its three-quarter inch rating. Measure carpet plus padding together, and read whether the rating counts both.
Polycarbonate is rigid, vinyl is softer and often thicker. Rigidity affects roll resistance. Look for the material name and thickness on the listing.
A lip lets the chair slide under the desk area. Larger mats give more rolling room. Measure your chair swing and compare with the listed dimensions.
Thicker mats resist bowing on soft carpet. Figures here run 0.11 to 0.2 inch. Check the thickness number rather than assuming.

faq.q: Do I need a chair mat on thick carpet?
faq.a: Yes, a mat gives a firm surface so the chair rolls. Choose one rated for your pile depth.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake?
faq.a: Buying a mat rated for low pile. It will bow, curl and rock on deep carpet.

faq.q: Is the Marvelux Extra Thick worth it?
faq.a: If you want one mat rated for every depth, yes. Otherwise the ES Robbins Extra High covers deep carpet for less.

faq.q: How do I measure carpet depth?
faq.a: Measure pile height plus any padding underneath. Compare the total with the mat's stated rating.
A lip extends under the desk for chair access. Choose one if you sit close to the desk.

faq.q: Will a mat stay put on carpet?
faq.a: Mats with cleated or gripped undersides tend to hold. Check the listing for a carpet grip description.

finalTake: The ES Robbins Extra High Pile mat with a lip is the best pick for deep carpet in a standard setup. Choose the Marvelux Extra Thick when you want one mat for any pile, and the Floortex Deep Pile mat for moderate plush carpet at a lower price.
